first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A bald person in the foreground with their back to the camera, with broad red markings on the light-colored head and neck and broad, thick shoulders and back, wearing brown protective gear and carrying weapons on their back.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A person with long black hair in the central midground, wearing a fitted dark green top and gray-blue hanging panels, drawing a bow toward image-right.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: A short-haired person straddling the saddle on Animal A's back, wearing a light gray-blue top, a dark belt, and trousers.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: A large gray-brown horned quadruped with thick curved horns on its head and golden armor plates covering its head and back, carrying Person C.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: Clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark forked branches at the top and upper-left of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: A spear-like weapon beside Person A, angled toward the upper-right of the image, with dark red hanging cloth tied near its slender silver front end.

entities.name: Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground
entities.identification: A low-lying, irregular orange-brown object on the ground to the image-right of Person B, with dark stripes and markings on its surface.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: A long-handled axe on the image-right side of Person A's back, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a brown handle extending downward.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: A nearly vertical longbow held by Person B, with alternating dark and light diagonal patterns on the bow and a thin string drawn toward the side of the head.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: A dark green-gray rectangular stone frame in the central background, with orange-brown wooden stakes arranged vertically inside the frame.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: A gray block-like facade in the right background, with some dark areas and a curved decorative outline on the upper portion.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: Thick gray-brown gnarled roots, thin vines, and green clinging plants on the gray stone facade on the right.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: Irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs, gravel, and narrow red-brown paved strips in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: Green clumps of grass, ground-hugging moss, and a small amount of broad-leaved vegetation in stone gaps, along stone edges, and on the midground ground.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: Red-orange clustered objects in multiple places on the midground ground, with spread-out, overlapping cap-like outlines.

entities.name: Boxes, Baskets, and Containers by the Wall
entities.identification: A group of brown square boxes, small baskets with curved handles, and dark round-bellied containers at the base of the wall on the left.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: A long silver-gray curved blade angled toward the lower-right of the image across Person A's back, with the dark brown grip at its upper end near the back of the neck.

At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy consists of large clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark forked branches.

At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy consists of layered clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark forked branches; leaf tips and some light-colored bright edges are discernible, the thin branches fork repeatedly, and there are deep dark gaps among the branches and leaves.
